title: Introduction to Python
description: Basics of Python including what it is, its history, features, and setting up the environment.

flashcards.question: What is Python?
flashcards.answer: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simplicity and readability.

flashcards.question: Who created Python and when?
flashcards.answer: Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.

flashcards.question: What are some key features of Python?
flashcards.answer: Easy to learn, interpreted, dynamically typed, extensive standard library, and supports multiple programming paradigms.

flashcards.question: Why is Python popular for beginners?
flashcards.answer: Because of its readable syntax, extensive documentation, and active community support.

flashcards.question: What does it mean that Python is an interpreted language?
flashcards.answer: Python code is executed line-by-line by the interpreter without prior compilation.

flashcards.question: Which environments can Python run on?
flashcards.answer: Python runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, and many other operating systems.

flashcards.question: What is the latest major version of Python as of 2024?
flashcards.answer: Python 3.x (Python 2 is no longer officially supported).

flashcards.question: How do you install Python on your system?
flashcards.answer: Download from python.org and follow installation instructions or use package managers like apt, brew, or chocolatey.

flashcards.question: What is the Python REPL?
flashcards.answer: Read-Eval-Print Loop, an interactive shell to write and test Python code instantly.
